title: Hide other studies from study jobs; configure Hermes Agent as a system
summary: For a study job naming system b, snapshots for reader, producer and verifier omit every other studies/<id>/ directory, hidden directories are never counted as deleted and land unchanged, and change jobs are unaffected. Then add [capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent] to athena.toml pinned at v2026.9.24, keeping firstmate. Audience: the owner enforcing BRIEF.md Part 2 S1 fresh-context separation.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check.
Isolation criteria check the snapshot contents and landed bytes by running tests.
One focused change: the hiding mechanism plus the one config entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs (Snapshot::create calls materialize, which drops records/ and athena-exclude paths via classify; the entry point), crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs (producer_snapshot), run/verification.rs, reading.rs, run/planning.rs (other Snapshot::create callers), run/pin.rs (pin_repo; study_pin lets studies/<id>/pin.json override repo_ref, otherwise the pinner resolves repo_ref), and crates/athena-data/src/config.rs (repo_url, repo_ref). Resolution and pinning run before dispatch; snapshots are created per role afterwards. The property is measured directly: files present on disk in each snapshot, and the change list / landed tree compared to the base. No new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are not touched.

Assumption: the systems schema ([capabilities.study.systems.<id>] with repo_url and repo_ref, and a way to select the system a study job names) exists in the base commit, as the request states. The copy I read lacks it. If the base lacks it the athena.toml entry will not parse, and the producer must stop and report instead of inventing the schema.

Design: Snapshot::create gains a list of hidden path prefixes (the other studies/<id>/ directories). The core computes it from the study id the job names and passes it for every role's snapshot of a study job. Change jobs pass an empty list. The hidden prefixes are removed in materialize alongside records/.

The hidden directories exist at the base. Change-list and landing logic must treat a path hidden from the snapshot as absent from both sides, not as deleted, so landing leaves studies/a byte-identical. This extends the existing handling of records/ and athena-exclude.
Existing code: crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/pin.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs, docs/design/study-capability-m1.md.
Consumers: crates/athena-core/src/run/pin.rs, crates/athena-cap-study/src/lib.rs (reads the study section of athena.toml).
Term ladder: not applicable; no structural terms are used.
Out of scope as stated: running Hermes, studying it, and the site. firstmate's config and studies/firstmate-work-handling/ stay unchanged.
question: The working copy I read has no [capabilities.study.systems] schema (no "systems" in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; pin.rs reads only [capabilities.study] repo_url/repo_ref). Does the job's base commit hold it?

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a test that parses the repository's own athena.toml passes, and with a fake pinner Hermes pins at v2026.9.24 from https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent while firstmate still pins the SHA in studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json.

Run cargo test: in a test repository with studies/a and studies/b, the reader, producer and verifier snapshots of a study job naming b lack studies/a and hold studies/b, and a change job's snapshots hold both.
Run cargo test: a hidden study directory is never reported as deleted in a change list, and studies/a is byte-identical after a fake-driver study job naming b runs to landing.

athena.toml (listed as a deliverable) contains [capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent] with repo_url https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git (or the URL without .git, matching firstmate's form) and repo_ref = "v2026.9.24", and the firstmate entry is unchanged in the diff.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check: both are clean.
CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing study snapshot isolation, the hidden-directory landing rule and the Hermes Agent system; the diff shows it.
The change refuses no more readings; it only hides paths from study snapshots, so no refusal-rate change is intended (expected 0% of newly refused readings).

out_of_scope: Studying Hermes Agent or writing studies/hermes-agent
Changing the firstmate configuration or its existing study
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: the change spans several snapshot callers in athena-core plus landing logic, and the schema precondition is uncertain.
hard_reason: It changes what the run pipeline's snapshots hide from agents (an isolation guard) and how landing treats hidden paths, so a mistake is costly and hard to see.
